title: Heights, balance factors and imbalance cases

tests.name: The four cases
tests.expr: [imbalance_case(build_tree(v)) for v in ([30, 20, None, 10], [10, None, 20, None, 30], [30, 10, None, None, 20], [10, None, 30, 20], [20, 10, 30])]

tests.name: Stored heights are ignored
tests.setup: root = Node(1, None, Node(2, None, Node(3)))
tests.hint: The height field isn't kept up to date here. Work heights out from the children.

tests.name: Unbalanced below the root
tests.setup: root = build_tree([50, 30, 70, 20, None, 60, 80, 10, None, None, None, None, 90])
tests.hint: The root's balance factor is 0, but node 30 has a balance factor of -2. Check every node.

tests.name: Heavy child with balance factor 0
tests.hint: When the heavy child's balance factor is 0, it's a single rotation (LL or RR). This happens after deletions.

tests.name: Large tree, one bad spot deep down
tests.data:
root = balanced_tree(0, 4095)
node = root
while node.left:
    node = node.left
node.left = Node(-1, Node(-2))
